title: Test-run observation updates publish narrow events, not a full ~14.8 MB state broadcast
outcome: Recording a test-command observation (persist_test_command_observation_locked) no longer triggers a full global StateResponse build and broadcast. It emits only the narrow TestRunChanged (or equivalent delta), with persistence, ACK and fence semantics unchanged.
acceptance: A regression test through the real state broadcaster records N test-command observation updates and asserts 0 additional full `state` events, with the expected TestRunChanged (or delta) events and unchanged TestRunChanged/fence outcomes; it fails on the current code (RED recorded) and passes after the fix.

Persistence and acknowledgement semantics of the observation path are unchanged (the observation is durably recorded before any acknowledgement it previously gated), proven by the existing observation/persistence tests still passing plus one test asserting the persisted record after the narrowed publication.

A one-time read-only measurement note records, on a host with the current session count, the full-state snapshot's size by component and the StateInner hold time while it's built, before and after the change; the full five-stage gate passes on the exact final input with an independent review pair having no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Completed the one-time post-restart live state measurement and recorded the component breakdown, session count, response time, and limits of the lock-time observation. Fresh independent acceptance evaluation a90bc945272c4dd797026cda0cf07cce passed all 3 criteria on the landed Train-4 revision; the no-action test obligation is handled by completion.
